input.statement: Evaluate the integral of exp(-x^2) over the whole real line.

cases.notes: Harness self-test case, not part of the evaluation set. Closed form checked by hand: the square of the integral is pi in polar coordinates. Its scripted model responses are in scripts/Q-selftest-gaussian.json.

input.statement: Differentiate x^2 * exp(x) with respect to x.
steps: By the product rule the derivative is 2*x*exp(x) + x^2*exp(x).

cases.notes: Harness self-test case, not part of the evaluation set. Step s2 carries the planted error: the factor should be (x^2 + 2*x). No Solve code exists yet, so nothing runs this case; it only exercises the format.
